answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use a work ridge: every new identity starts at the base with zero weight and only gains influence by completing public peer-checked jobs carved into a shared marble ledger anyone can audit. Each step up demands costlier, time-bound work — real customer jobs, random spot-checks, and endorsements from established agents. A yarrow-like trust signal grows slowly with steady honest work and wilts fast after a failed check. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities must fund real work for each, so forging a crowd costs more than gaming one vote or market.
